carolina.event.title:
Intensive tango weekend with 
Carolina Jador
carolina.event.subtitle: 4 Workshops + 1 Milonga with 2 argentinians TDJ for an authentic tango experience.
carolina.event.intro: Carolina Jador is an Argentine tango dancer and teacher with nearly 30 years of experience. She develops her artistic activity both in Argentina and internationally as a teacher, choreographer, DJ, and tango event organizer.
carolina.event.training.title: Training
carolina.event.training.text:
She began her training in classical and Spanish dance, later expanding into Argentine tango, folk dances, contemporary dance, jazz, salsa, bachata, and Latin rhythms.

She has trained with renowned tango masters such as Miguel Ángel Zotto, Fabián Peralta, Gabriel Missé, Sebastián Achával, Demian García, Alejandra Martiñán, and Roberto Herrera, among others.
carolina.event.professional.title: Professional Activity
carolina.event.professional.text:
For over 28 years, she has been teaching tango in cultural, educational, and social environments.

She is employed by the Municipality of Santa Fe, where she contributes to the teaching and promotion of tango.
carolina.event.work.title: She also works as:
carolina.event.work.organizer: Organizer of tango seminars and events
carolina.event.international.title: International Experience
carolina.event.international.text: She has toured and taught across Europe and Brazil, offering classes, seminars, performances, and DJing at milongas in various cultural venues.
carolina.event.cultural.title: Cultural Management
carolina.event.cultural.text:
She is the creator of the milonga "Taconeando con la Morocha", with an 18-year history, officially recognized as a cultural event at municipal, provincial, and national levels.

Through this project, she has hosted renowned artists such as Miguel Ángel Zotto and Roberto Herrera, as well as prestigious orchestras like Orquesta Típica La Juan D’Arienzo and Sexteto Milonguero.

carolina.program.title: Event Program
carolina.program.subtitle:
The workshops theme:
The embrace as the main engine of the dance
carolina.program.event1.title:
13:00 – 14:30
Workshop 1: Tango
carolina.program.event1.desc: Adornos & voleos: We explore how to add style and personality to our dance while maintaining connection and musicality.
carolina.program.2event1.title:
14:45 – 16:15
Workshop 2: Tango
carolina.program.2event1.desc: Pivots & ganchos: We delve into the mechanics of pivots and ganchos, understanding how to integrate them seamlessly into our dance.
carolina.program.event2.title:
21:00 – 02:00
Special milonga with 2 argentinian TDJs
carolina.program.event2.desc: A special evening to experience the authentic atmosphere of a Buenos Aires milonga, with two Argentine TDJs Carolina Jador & Francisco Iturrieta.
carolina.program.event3.title:
14:30 – 16:00
Workshop 3: Milonga
carolina.program.event3.desc: Cadence & traspiés: We focus on the rhythmic aspects of tango, exploring how to create and play during our dance.
carolina.program.2event3.title:
16:15 – 17:45
Workshop 4: Vals
carolina.program.2event3.desc: Sequences with sacadas. We explore the world of Vals, learning how to create fluid sequences with sacadas.
